title: Split Open songs
description: songs.yaml: the songs in the player, in picker order. See README.md. The checks scripts/check-songs.py adds beyond this schema: the id is unique, the band is in bands.yaml, the date is a real date, dir ends with /<id>/ and holds meta.json and every segment of the song's stems.

id.description: The song's id: the first part of the URL hash, the name of its directory in the bucket and of its folder under guides/. By convention <date>-<title slug>.

band.description: The band's key in bands.yaml, whose lineup gives the song its stems.

date.description: The date of the show, YYYY-MM-DD. Kept as a string: in YAML 1.2, which the player reads, 1998-07-26 is text.

set.description: The set the song is from (Set I, Set II, Encore), if known.

city.description: City and state or country, as in Dallas, TX.

source.description: The page the recording came from, usually an archive.org item; the date in the venue line links to it.

dir.description: Where the stems are: the song's directory URL in the bucket, or audio/songs/<id>/ for a local copy, with a trailing slash.

hidden.description: true keeps the song out of the picker; it still plays from a direct link.

channels.description: Changes to the band's lineup for the night: per stem, a new who and/or inst. A stem the band lacks can be added here with both.
